meta.name: run-tests
meta.description: Runs the Isaac Lab-Arena pytest suite across its three required phases (no-cameras, with-cameras, with-subprocess) inside the running isaaclab_arena Docker container. Use when the user asks to run the tests, test their changes, verify the test suite passes, check whether a change broke anything (e.g. "did I break anything", "do the tests still pass", "is everything still working"), run only one specific phase (e.g. "run Phase 1", "run only the no-camera tests", "skip the camera and subprocess tests"), or run coverage for a specific module.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行测试套件，验证代码变更是否通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速验证 Isaac Lab-Arena 的代码变更是否通过测试
copy.tagline_en: Run the test suite to verify code changes pass
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly verify that your Isaac Lab-Arena code changes pass the test suite

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在 Docker 容器中运行 Isaac Lab-Arena 测试套件的三个阶段（无相机、有相机、有子进程），并依次报告结果。若某阶段失败，会停止并告知第一个失败的测试文件、函数和错误。
howto.when: 当你说“运行测试”、“检查是否弄坏了什么”、“只运行 Phase 1”等要求时触发。

say.note: Claude 会依次执行三个阶段的测试。
只运行无相机、无子进程的测试。

say.text: 检查我的更改有没有破坏测试
say.note: Claude 运行完整测试并报告结果。

howto.what_en: When asked to run tests, Claude executes the three phases (no-cameras, with-cameras, with-subprocess) inside the Docker container, reports results per phase, and stops on first failure with details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to run tests, verify if something broke, or run a specific test phase (e.g., phase1, phase2, phase3).

say_en.note: Claude runs the three phases sequentially.

say_en.text: Check if my changes broke anything
say_en.note: Claude runs full test suite and reports.
